programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nürburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Mustang celebrates its 50th anniversary at the Las Vegas Raceways and Marco takes part in this special event. He witnesses how tailor-made Shelby Cobras are manufactured and continues on his road trip through the US.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: How do conservative Californian petrolheads respond to a modern hybrid sports car like the BMW i8? On Marco's road trip through L.A. octane junkies who usually drive a Porsche 911, a Corvette or tuned bikes take the BMW to the test.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Kati from Munich is a big fan of US cars. She and her boyfriend fulfilled their dreams by buying a 1972 Chevy Chevelle that was found and imported directly from the USA by Frank Slopianka and his company Special Cars Berlin.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck is one of the best racing drivers in Germany. Over his long career he not only won the Formula II and several international touring car championships multiple times but also the famous 24-hour race of Le Mans twice.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The IAA in Frankfurt is the largest motor show in the world. More than 900 exhibitors present their new products in 11 halls and on 14 outdoor areas. Here you can marvel at tomorrow's trends today.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The tuning forge SKN from Benstorf is organising a Dyno Day for the second time. Also: Lorinser refines the Mercedes E 500 Coupé. And: an invitation to Raeder Motorsport.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Patrick Simon tests the Aston Martin Zagato on the Grand Prix circuit. Also: Renault Megane Sport vs. Golf GTI Edition 35. And: the Porsche 997 and 994 on the Nordschleife.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Once a year, Las Vegas hosts the largest car and tuning trade show in the world - the SEMA Show. We show the highlights from hot rods to custom cars.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The car tuner Lorinser looks back on more than 30 years of experience in tuning Mercedes Benz cars. Also: aeroplane vs. Porsche GT3. And: in an Aston Martin on the Nordschleife.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Essen Motor Show is the event for automobile and motor sports enthusiasts. Over 300,000 visitors flock here every year and bring the hallowed halls to a boil.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: No consumer good is fought over as fiercely and as cost-intensively as the car. No sooner had the first car been launched in 1886 than advertising began touting the great benefits of the motor car for mankind. Part 1 of 3.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, car production booms and with it car advertising. Television advertising for cars picks up speed. Even the oil crisis cannot stop worldwide car production or the corresponding advertising. Part 2 of 3.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In no other industry is marketing as important as in the automotive industry. Brands, models and advertising campaigns have been closely intertwined for decades. How has car advertising developed since the 1990s? Part 3 of 3.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Chevrolet Corvette is the best-selling sports car in the world. It belongs to the USA like the Statue of Liberty, the Superbowl and John Wayne. Since its market launch the Corvette has developed into an automotive icon.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: 50 years of Porsche 911, 60 years of Chevrolet Corvette: two legends, two myths, two dream cars, and two philosophies. The Porsche 911 and the Chevrolet Corvette are the sports car icons in Europe and the USA.

programme.title: Concorso d'Eleganza at Lake Como
programme.desc: Lake Como is home to a very special classic car meeting: the Concorso d'Eleganza. For decades, the rich and beautiful have met here with their beautiful and valuable cars - the unique classics of automobile history.

programme.title: Wanderer Stromlinie Spezial
programme.desc: Founded in 1885, the Wanderer-Werke AG was one of the three biggest German car manufacturing companies at the time of WWII. The three remaining original Wanderer Stromlinie Spezial racing cars were lost in the turmoil of the war, but Audi ordered specialist Werner Zinke to create replicas of these three iconic classic cars.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nürburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Mustang celebrates its 50th anniversary at the Las Vegas Raceways and Marco takes part in this special event. He witnesses how tailor-made Shelby Cobras are manufactured and continues on his road trip through the US.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: How do conservative Californian petrolheads respond to a modern hybrid sports car like the BMW i8? On Marco's road trip through L.A. octane junkies who usually drive a Porsche 911, a Corvette or tuned bikes take the BMW to the test.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Kati from Munich is a big fan of US cars. She and her boyfriend fulfilled their dreams by buying a 1972 Chevy Chevelle that was found and imported directly from the USA by Frank Slopianka and his company Special Cars Berlin.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck is one of the best racing drivers in Germany. Over his long career he not only won the Formula II and several international touring car championships multiple times but also the famous 24-hour race of Le Mans twice.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The compact cars Mercedes A45 AMG Performmaster and MTM Audi RS3 R are loud, fast and extremely honed. In addition we examine the myth of Ferrari and take a look behind the scenes of the Rolls Royce Bespoke production.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The Route 66 from Chicago to Santa Monica is the most legendary road in the world. Following the old Highway you can experience the myth behind this former arterial road. Plus: A double-pack of GTR with the Nissan GTR and Mercedes-AMG GT R.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: With its Model S, American carmaker Tesla wants to establish electric engines in the full-size class. For the first time it is possible to attain driving ranges over 400 kilometers. And: with its Panamera Sport Turismo, Porsche taps into a new market.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: With the Toyota GT 86 from J-Sport, it is noticeable that the company's roots lie in racing. The fans' wish to give the Japanese racer significantly more power nevertheless remained unfulfilled.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and the other competitors in the business class segment. Volvo take a different approach. Their S90 is captivating due to its Scandinavian design and economical four-cylinder engines.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: BMW offers the X2 as a compact hipster SUV for young people. The DS 7 Crossback, on the other hand, wants to convey the French lifestyle. And Jaguar's E-Pace enters the market as a smaller version of the F-Pace.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: With the compact SUV Velar, Range Rover attempts to reach a broader audience. Jeep relies on the tried and tested: the design of the Wrangler has remained almost the same for more than 60 years. Also: the Volvo XC60 and the Ford Edge.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter still is one of the most popular commercial vehicles. For its third generation, the brand chose to have it manufactured in Poland. Before, this iconic van shared its production line with Volkswagen's Crafter.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Porsche quits the diesel business. Hybrids such as the Cayenne E-Hybrid are expected to become their focus of attention. Also: taking the BMW X4 on tour around Spartanburg, USA. And: mountain climbing with the Volkswagen Touareg in Austria.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.

programme.title: Joseph Stalin's ZIS 110
programme.desc: James Bond still didn't have a license to kill, when this representative Russian vehicle called ZIS 110 rolled off the production line in 1949. The 110 was developed by reverse engineering a 1942 Packard Super Eight.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the end of the 1960s, under adverse conditions, Heinz Melkus built the GDR's only sports car, the Melkus RS 1000 with lightweight plastic bodywork and gullwing doors. Also: Audi resurrects the Wanderer streamline racing cars.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Samba transforms from pack mule into high-priced classic. And: a former letter box with 37 seats. The 1962 'Graf and Stift' post bus now takes tourists to their hotel.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The BMW 503 four-seater convertible is one of BMW's most exclusive models. Also: Inspector Columbo's Peugeot 403 Cabrio. And: pre-war elegance with 1950s technology, the Mercedes S 170.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: More than 50 years ago, DKW presented their last car, the F 12 Roadster. Also: how a Ford Mustang ended up on top of the Empire State Building. And: more than 50 years of turbo power, the Porsche 911 Turbo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: High-tech turbo cars from the wild 1980s are reunited at the Salzburgring race track. Also: the Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, a small Italian two-seater with mid-engine offers classic car driving pleasure at a low entry price.

programme.title: Bayer K 67
programme.desc: Modern materials and new production methods and a progressive look. In 1967, the Bayer K 67 concept car seemed to come directly from the future. It gave an outlook on the possible future production of series automobiles.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Volvo breathes new life into the sedan segment, with the ES 90. The Renault Kiger receives a mid-life make over and Ernest get better acquainted with the Leapmotor C10.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: We explore how long a high-mileage Honda CR-V can last, help an Audi A3 owner plan long-term without a warranty, and guide a first-time buyer in choosing the right German car now.

programme.title: IGNITION Goes to SEMA
programme.desc: Vic brings you yet another varied line-up of ultra desirable custom-built vehicles in this episode: from a carbon fibre bodied, classic Ford pickup to an air-cooled Porsche 911 Targa and a slammed Mercedes-Benz CLS.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: We’re down at the Cape Town Motorshow for the world record breaking sound off. Vic chats to up and coming spinner Brian Sto. And car enthusiast Calvin Fisher gives us a look at the 911 GT3 RS.

programme.title: Alfa Romeo 6C 2500SS
programme.desc: Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: German Engineering stands for quality, precision and, above all, impressive cars. Prime examples of this are the 135 million euro SLR and the AMG One. Also: the BMW M240i and the Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S E Performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: These family station wagons provide a real adrenaline rush. The specialists at MTM catapult the Audi RS6 Avant with 1001 hp into the hypercar league. And the 408 hp AMG C43 is supposed to be more than just a family transporter. We put them to the test.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Extreme everyday cars. Using the Mercedes-AMG C 63 S E Performance and the Audi RS4/RS5 with Competition Package as examples, we show how two mid-range cars are transformed into sports cars ready for the racetrack.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two GT models that provide surprising power and driving pleasure away from the usual brands. Petrol versus electric. Which Kia is more convincing? And: the Hyundai Kona N, a compact powerhouse.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: We highlight the history of the AMG S-Class from its beginnings to the present day and take a look at the most powerful vehicle in this model series to date, the Mercedes-AMG S 63 S E Performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 27 derivatives - the selection of Porsche 911s has never been so large. And never before have you been able to see all the models in one place - until now! We go speed dating with the Porsche 992 - which model will win the heart of the Bachelor?

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi is the most glamorous race track of the Formula One. Khaled Qubaysi takes us for a spin on this exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the famous race track.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Stéphane Peterhansel is the most successful driver in the history of the Dakar Rally. With the German team X-Raid he won the 2012 and 2013 editions of this prestigious competition in a Mini Countryman.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: For more than a century man and machine have tried to tame the Pikes Peak mountain, where daredevils risk everything to be the fastest up the 20-kilometer road to the summit at 4,300 meters above sea level. We show you the highlights of the 2018 race.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Former World Rally champion Armin Schwarz is a legend behind the wheel. We accompanied him when he instructed other talented drivers in a Subaru WRX STI rally car in the snowy and icy, but also breathtaking landscape of Finland.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Tourist Trophy on the British Isle of Man is the most famous motorcycle race in the world. TT Sidecar champion Klaus Klaffenböck and racing expert Lenz Leberkern explore the fascination behind this exciting and iconic racing event.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: 1963, over 50 years ago, with the Quattroporte Maserati invented a new vehicle category, the sports sedan. This GTS model is already the 6th generation of this iconic car.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Juliet gets behind the wheel of the eagerly awaited Lexus RZ. Lepas kicks off their local product onslaught with the L4 and Zee gets acquainted with Omoda’s new mid-range C7.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: We assess a Nissan Qashqai to decide if repairs are worth it, revisit a high-mileage Fortuner for long-term ownership, and compare reliable 7-seater options.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 439 - KOK - Best of part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings from Lithuania. Walid Poyan faces Emilijus Kaganovicius in the Lightweight division and Ilir Bega steps into the ring with Ignas Pauliukevicius for a Heavyweight bout. Also in this episode Ivans Kozecenkovs and Deividas Zamba take to the ring for what's expected to be a highly intense battle. Marius Kutauskas, making his pro-debut is matched up against Samuelis Sorochovas. Watch as Likas Lapinskas takes on Arturs Skabarnieks in an MMA Heavyweight bout and in a Lightweight matchup, Morroco's Anas Hilboui takes on Afghanistan's Tamim Shariffi in a very evenly matched fight. Also, in a Lightweight bout, Christiano Silva faces off against the much more experienced Mindaugas Narauskas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 440 - Shamrock FC 364
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 364 from Kansas City, Missouri. On the card tonight, Robert Fichtner takes on fan favorite Anthony Dooley in the Bantamweight division. Caleb Williams and Brynn Heathcock faceoff for a Catchweight bout. In the Light Heavyweight Division, undefeated Glendal Whitney puts his record on the line when he steps into the cage with Kameron Kemp in the co-main event. In the main event Timehin Babaloa takes on Dan Olajiga in what's expected to be a fight of attrition.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 441 - Up Next Fighting – Migran vs. Douglas
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting: Migran Vs. Douglas from Southern California. In this episode "Westside" Dion Young looks to replicate his KO of the night when he steps into the cage with Sexyama Albert Lee. In a featherweight championship bout, Hamzeh Trad and undefeated Shane Collins take to the cage in a battle for the belt. In the main event, Olympic silver medalist Migran "The Maestro" Arutyunyan faces off against David "Tarzan" Douglas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 442 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions III part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions III part 1 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, Califorinia. In this episode Letryle Pearson making his pro debut faces Louis Vasquez in the super-middleweight division. Plus undefeated Chelsey "Mae Mae" Anderson returns to the ring to take on Mexico's Claudia Herrera and in the main event, undefeated and lightning fast "Terrible" Terry Washington takes on the experienced Nelvis "Tricky Train" Rodriguez who looks to end Washington's perfect record.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 445 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions III part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions III part 1 from the historic Fox Theater in Pomona, Califorinia. Tonight watch as Brandon Douglas from Salt Lake City takes on undefeated Javier Zamarron from Wisconsin in the featherweight division. Also Emmanuel Dominguez and Micheal Bracamontes take to the ring in the lightweight division in a match of youth versus strength.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 446 - CMH Boxing I part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing I part 1. In this initial episode of Championing Mental Health Boxing, Marlen Avila faces the young and undefeated Poison Ivy Enriquez. Watch as Jose Ramirez steps into the ring with Jessie Mandapat looking for an upset. Also on this card, promising up and comer Jonny "Magic" Mansour is matched up against Christian Avalos who looks to end Jonny's undefeated streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 452 - CMH Boxing I part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing I part 2 from the Avalon in Hollywood. In the women's division, Brook Sibrian of California takes on the younger Rubi Gutierriz out of Mexico. In the co-main event, Victor Pisillas is set to meet the challenge with Carlos Jackson in a crossroads fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 436 - Shamrock 362
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 362 from St. Louis, Missouri at the Ameristar Casino. First up, Nuriel Henry from Jamaica faces hometown favorite Eric Polovina and David Fraizer steps into the cage with Billy Duncan. In the main event, Featherweight champ Dustin Lampros drops a weightclass to take on Lorenzo Carter for the Bantamweight title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 439 - KOK - Best of part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings from Lithuania. Walid Poyan faces Emilijus Kaganovicius in the Lightweight division and Ilir Bega steps into the ring with Ignas Pauliukevicius for a Heavyweight bout. Next up, Stefan Orza and Eduard Gafencu look to give fans a fight of the night. In two heavyweight matchups, Florin Ivanoaie faces Cristian Ristea and Ionut Iancu faces Sebastian Cozmanca.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 351 - KOK 103 World Series Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 103 part 1 from Tallinn, Estonia. Kicking things off tonight Lithuanian Gedminas Justinas takes on Moldova's Sergei Cheles. In back to back female boxing events, Ernesta Kareckaite faces the more experienced Sigrid Kapanen and Aleksandra Dzhikaeva gets in the ring with Karolina Arm. Making his pro debut, Romualdas Auga takes on Aleksandrs Cerkesov.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 352 - KOK 103 World Series Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 103 part 2 from Tallinn, Estonia. In a welterweight Grand Prix, Raimondas Avlasevicius faces Roman Jarysh in the first semi-final fight and in the second semi-final fight Dzianis Makouski joins Marko Sults in the ring with the winner moving on to the Grand Prix finals in the co-main event. Also in this episode, in a very evenly matched bout, Aleh Moshnin and Henry Rohtla face off in the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 353 - KOK 103 World Series Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 103 part 3 from Tallinn, Estonia. In tonight's episode in a middleweight bout Richardas Kulis of Lithuania fights Aleksei Larin from Estonia. In a bantamweight championship female fight, Ilona Wojda and Astrid Grents battle it out for the title. Also Ukranian Volodymyr Hynzhu faces Estonia's Hendrik Themas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 356 - CFC Mursa Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 2 from Malta. In a boxing contest, Italian Damiano Calicchia gets in the cage with Cleavin Falzon of Malta. Also, watch as the winners of the semi-finals four man tournament battle for the win to move on to the championship in Brazil.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 355 - CFC Mursa Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 1 from Malta. In a four man tournament, Jonathan Carlos out of Brazil who is on a winning streak faces Argentinian Matias Juarez. Next up two Brazilians battle to move on in the tournament as Joao Luis Nogueira takes on Felipe Douglas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 348 - CFC 13 Non Ducor, Duco
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 13, Non Ducor Duco from Sao Paulo Brazil. This episode features a four man tournament. In the first match of the night Fabrico Martins faces Bruno Tavares and in the second match Leandro Rodrigues faces Antonio Monteiro. The two winners will move on to the main event.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 347 - Up Next Fighting (UNF) 9 Part 1 - Rivera vs. Wang-Kim
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 9 from Southern California. In a heavyweight bout Sean Sharaf takes on Nathan Mullett and Anthony Romero faces Brandon Aviles. The main event features a title fight between Cisco Rivera with 10 KO's and Contender Series Josh Wang Kim in the bantamweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 349 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 1 from Bucharest Romania. Watch four kickboxing battles on this episode of UFA. Starting out The Ironman, Denis Ceausu takes on Marius Cimpoeru, then Ali Gokturk Benli faces Andrei Leustean in a Turkey versus Romania bout. Florentin Ionescu takes on the more experienced Mihai Zmarandescu and Omer Pisgin takes on fan favorite The Shephard, Bogdan Nastase.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 350 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 2 from Bucharest Romania with a night of Kickboxing action. Starting off in the heavyweight division, Poland's Dominik Jedrejczyk takes on Romania's Claudiu Badoi in a David versus Goliath fight. Next up, Stefan Orza and Eduard Gafencu look to give fans a fight of the night. In two heavyweight matchups, Florin Ivanoaie faces Cristian Ristea and Ionut Iancu faces Sebastian Cozmanca.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 430- Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. Up first in the middle weight division Denis Ceausu faces Andrei Varga. In the open weight division with a huge weight differential Rodrigo Mineiro, kickboxing world champion takes on boxer Bogdan Bestea for a boxing versus kickboxing contest. Watch as Alex Leautaund of the Netherlands takes on Romania's Mihai Desrobitu in a cruiserweight boxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 433 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. First up, a Superfight in the welterweight division, Bogdan Floristean versus Ionel Balan. In the women's lightweight division Maria Nitescu takes on Andreea Cebuc to determine the Baddest Woman in Romania. Also on this episode in the open division Tibor Varga of Hungary steps into the ring with Romania's Bogdan Nastase in a David versus Goliath duel.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 437 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of boxing and kickboxing fights. In the welterweight division Vinicius Bereta takes on Valentin Mavrodin in a Brazil versus Romania bout. In the open weight division Tolea Ciumac steps into the ring with Valentin Lambagiu with 100 pounds and over 20 years difference between the two fighters for a David versus Goliath duel. In the main event, Portugal's Iuri Fernandes faces Romania's Bogdan Stoica, with a stunning 58 wins to his name, in the Heavyweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 432- Shamrock 361
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 361 from Kansas City, Missouri. In the opening match, Ethan Hall steps into the cage with Bryson Osborne and Kylen Snider takes on Torry Moore in the welterweight division. Also on this card, Soy Migo and Misael Monarrez are set to take the challenge. In the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks faces Willie Henderson, making his pro-debut in a kickboxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 434 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 1 from Houston, Texas. In the first match, Stephen Acosta takes on Brian Soto in a four round super flyweight bout. In the 8 round co-main event undefeated Antonio Perez faces veteran boxer Alex Martin in the Superlight weight division

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 438 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 2 from Houston, Texas. In the Featherweight division, Emmanuel Carrillo Jr. takes on Jordan Najar. In the main event, undefeated Bantamweights Khalid Twaiti and Emanuel Moreno face off in an eight round matchup after an contentious weighin.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 436 - Shamrock 362
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 362 from St. Louis, Missouri at the Ameristar Casino. First up, Nuriel Henry from Jamaica faces hometown favorite Eric Polovina and David Fraizer steps into the cage with Billy Duncan. In the main event, Featherweight champ Dustin Lampros drops a weightclass to take on Lorenzo Carter for the Bantamweight title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 439 - KOK - Best of part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings from Lithuania. Walid Poyan faces Emilijus Kaganovicius in the Lightweight division and Ilir Bega steps into the ring with Ignas Pauliukevicius for a Heavyweight bout. Also in this episode Ivans Kozecenkovs and Deividas Zamba take to the ring for what's expected to be a highly intense battle. Marius Kutauskas, making his pro-debut is matched up against Samuelis Sorochovas. Watch as Likas Lapinskas takes on Arturs Skabarnieks in an MMA Heavyweight bout and in a Lightweight matchup, Morroco's Anas Hilboui takes on Afghanistan's Tamim Shariffi in a very evenly matched fight. Also, in a Lightweight bout, Christiano Silva faces off against the much more experienced Mindaugas Narauskas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 258 - UFA Presents the Fighter's Only World MMA Awards XIII
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the 13th annual Fighter's Only 2021 World MMA Awards from Worre Studios in Las Vegas, hosted by Chael Sonnen. Presentations by Dave Farra, Jessy Jess, Doggface208, Emily Whitmire, Cassie Scherbo, Jay Hieron, Dan Henderson, Kayla Harrison, Mackenzie Dern, and more.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 259 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 1. Young Estonian fighters Stanislav Teniugin and Siim Viljus battle under KOK Kickboxing rules. Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 Animals
programme.desc: GoPro Animals delivers heartwarming, hilarious, and jaw-dropping moments from the animal world. Wildlife photographer Chris Barnard captures the wild up close, even surviving a giraffe’s mighty kick. programme.title: S1E1 El Nino
programme.desc: Chasing El Niño follows Chris Benchetler on an epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the vast slopes of British Columbia. Joined by longtime friends Bryan Fox, Scotty Smith, and Canadian pro skier Nick McNutt, Chris explores previously inaccessible terrain, searches for perfect powder, and faces challenging weather conditions. Along the way, the crew embraces the joy of skiing, building creative jumps at their campsite and making the most of every moment on the mountain. This episode captures the thrill of exploration, friendship, and the relentless pursuit of epic lines.

programme.title: S1E2 El Nino
programme.desc: Chris Benchetler continues his epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the massive slopes of British Columbia. This time, X Games gold medalist Jossi Wells joins him for "The Sierra Trifecta," tackling skiing, climbing, and biking all in a single day. Chris and his crew hike 6,000 vertical feet through rugged rock fields to chase the last snow of the season in the Sierras, pushing their limits and capturing every thrilling moment.

Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E1 Moto
programme.desc: Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa on the adventure of a lifetime as they explore the vibrant cities and stunning beaches of Morocco. Plus, enjoy exclusive bonus footage featuring the very best of GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto
programme.desc: The journey continues as we follow two brothers on their 2,300-kilometer adventure across Morocco. Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto
programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E1 Driven
programme.desc:
GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN takes you deep inside the world of Supercross and Motocross champion James Stewart. Ride alongside the man known as the fastest on two wheels as he shares the highs, lows, and relentless drive that shaped his legendary career.
GoPro Original Series DRIVEN also follows X Games star and snowmobile icon Chris Burandt. Join him on a thrilling journey to discover what fuels his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. This is raw, high-octane storytelling you can’t miss.

programme.title: S1E2 Driven
programme.desc: In this episode of GoPro Original Series DRIVEN, we continue our in-depth look at X Games star and snowmobile legend Chris Burandt. Join him on an adrenaline-fueled journey to uncover what drives his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. The second part goes inside the life of three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano. Watch as he pushes the limits on the track and discovers how he uses his racing platform to make a difference in the lives of others.

programme.title: S1E3 Driven
programme.desc: Three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano continues to push the limits on the track while finding new ways to use his racing platform to make a positive impact on others. In this episode of GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN, step into the world of DC Shoes co-founder, rally car driver, and marketing mastermind Ken Block. Strap in for an electrifying journey through the moments and passions that have fueled his remarkable career.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 Adventure Series
programme.desc: Join “The Lion Whisperer” Kevin Richardson and a fearless team of conservationists on an epic mission to protect the planet’s most majestic and endangered predators. From rescuing lions at the Kevin Richardson Wildlife Sanctuary in South Africa to safeguarding orangutans and Cape Griffons in the wilds of Indonesia, witness heart-pounding rescues, fierce battles against exploitation, and inspiring stories of survival. This is conservation at its most daring—unmissable, unforgettable, and truly wild.

programme.title: S1E2 Adventure Series
programme.desc: Join “The Lion Whisperer” Kevin Richardson and a fearless team of conservationists on an epic mission to protect the planet’s most majestic and endangered predators. programme.title: S2E1 Adventure Series
programme.desc: From polar bears to roaring lions—this is GoPro Adventures at its wildest. Dive into jaw-dropping encounters with lions, whales, turtles, giraffes, and watch “The Lion Whisperer” Kevin Richardson at his South African sanctuary, where rescued predators find a second chance. It’s the ultimate fusion of wildlife wonder and high-octane thrills—you won’t be able to look away.

programme.title: S2E2 Adventure Series
programme.desc: Motorbikes, speed, and pure adrenaline—this is the ultimate GoPro adventure. Ride with Mexican enduro master Didier Goirand, push limits alongside British racing icon Maria Costello, the only female motorcycle racer ever to be awarded an MBE, and feel the thrill with American motorsports legend and DC Shoes founder Ken Block. High-octane action, world-class talent, and breathtaking moments—you won’t want to miss a second.

programme.title: S1E1 Animals
programme.desc: GoPro Animals delivers heartwarming, hilarious, and jaw-dropping moments from the animal world. From Golden Retrievers, French Bulldogs, and Border Collies bringing endless puppy smiles, to rescuing orcas and swimming with humpback whales, this show has it all. Wildlife photographer Chris Barnard captures the wild up close, even surviving a giraffe’s mighty kick. Plus, join Ocean Conservation Namibia as they race to save seals trapped in deadly ocean debris. A must-watch for every animal lover.

programme.title: S1E1 NHL After Dark
programme.desc: In this episode, NHL and GoPro team up to show the game from the perspective of some of hockey’s greatest players. On NHL After Dark, Detroit Red Wings forward Tomáš Tatar puts his street hockey skills to the test with challenging stickhandling drills. Pittsburgh Penguins center Evgeni Malkin, three-time Stanley Cup champion and 2012 Hart Memorial Trophy winner, showcases his smooth hands and technical mastery as he takes on drills that look simple but are far from easy. Chicago Blackhawks defender Duncan Keith elevates target practice to an art form while outmaneuvering his opponents with precision and speed.

programme.title: S1E2 NHL After Dark
programme.desc: In this episode, NHL and GoPro join forces to capture the game through the eyes of hockey’s best players. Vancouver Canucks duo Daniel and Henrik Sedin showcase their legendary on-ice chemistry through a series of unconventional drills. Philadelphia Flyers center Claude Giroux returns for his second episode, using lightning-fast hands and impressive physicality to outmaneuver his opponents. Colorado Avalanche forward Gabriel Landeskog powers through defenders and scores hard-hitting goals that put our cameras to the ultimate test. New Jersey Devils goalie Cory Schneider takes on unique drills that double the challenge and push his skills to the limit.

programme.desc: A true godfather of his sport, Edgar Torronteras, has pioneered FMX and is without a doubt one of the key men responsible for making it what it is today.

programme.title: Born To S1 - "Nani Roma"
programme.desc: Nani Roma has raced cars and bikes in his professional career. However, Nani doesn't race in normal competitions on normal circuits. He races in the Dakar Rally.

programme.title: Born To S1 - "Kiara Fontanesi"
programme.desc: Kiara Fontanesi has an impressive trophy cabinet. She is the 5 times winner of the Women Motocross World Championship, winning 4 of those years in succession.

programme.title: Dangers of Dark Fest S2 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: The fourth edition of Dark Fest gets underway. The first episode focuses on how the event was organized and experienced by the riders and audience.

programme.title: Dangers of Dark Fest S2 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In this episode we discover the fanaticism of the riders. How do they achieve their success during such a dangerous event? The answer turns out to be friendship.

programme.title: Inside the Masters of Dirt S2 - "When it Rains, it Pours"
programme.desc: In Beirut, the Masters of Dirt crew prepare to put on yet another epic show in the Middle East. But even in the hottest countries - when it rains, it pours! See why this tour stop goes down as one of the most challenging in recent M.O.D history!

programme.title: Inside the Masters of Dirt S2 - "Wibmer’s Wonderland"
programme.desc: What starts as a business trip to Innsbruck for Georgie and Bienve, turns into a reunion with MTB icon - Fabio Wibmer. Discover how the YouTube superstar lives, how Georgie overcomes his fears, and witness some of the most epic riding of the season.

programme.title: Inside the Masters of Dirt S2 - "Desert Sessions"
programme.desc: On the way to their live show in Chile, the crew’s entire plan falls apart while Georgie and some of the team are stranded in the Middle East. But in true M.O.D style, the guys maintain a positive attitude that leads to an insane trip.

Xavier is his 15 year old autistic nephew, and as he loves cycling as much as him, Adrien wanted to help the association “Des Rêves pour Xavier” (Dreams for Xavier) to finance an electric tandem. Adrien’s other goal was to raise autism awareness among as many people as possible.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: Latest News & Updates
programme.desc: Watch the latest news and programming for HorizonSports.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 3
programme.desc: Starting this episode, we are visiting Oman for the IODA Asia & Oceania Championship 2025, a leading youth sailing event that attracts hundreds of participants each year. We move on with an unmissable event that will take place in Palma, from March 27 to April 4. The 55th Trofeo Princesa Sofia Mallorca by FERGUS Hotels, as the first scoring event for the 2026 Sailing Grand Slam. Sailing Grand Slam, developed in close collaboration with World Sailing, is an international series of elite Olympic watersport events, uniting all 10 Olympic disciplines –across sailing, windsurfing and kiteboarding– into one integrated Grand Prix-style circuit in Europe and the United States. Following the event in Palma, the next event is Semaine Olympique Française in Hyeres.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.1
programme.desc: La 40e édition de la Pierra Menta, qui compte également pour le championnat du monde longue distance (ISMF), a démarré sur les chapeaux de roue, animée par les duels franco- français attendus. The 40th edition of the Pierra Menta, which also counts towards the ISMF long-distance world championship, got off to a flying start, enlivened by the expected Franco-French duels.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.3
programme.desc: Au terme d’une 3e étape champagne, les coureurs de la 40e pierra menta ont régalé les centaines de spectateurs montés au sommet du Grand Mont. Le général est bouleversé par la performance d’Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel. William Bon Mardion et Xavier Gachet résistent et confirment leur statut de favoris. At the end of a thrilling third stage, the runners of the 40th Pierra Menta delighted the hundreds of spectators who had climbed to the summit of Grand Mont. The overall standings were shaken up by the performances of Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel. William Bon Mardion and Xavier Gachet held their own and confirmed their status as favorites.

programme.title: World Rookie Snowboard Finals 2026
programme.desc: After a winter packed with World Rookie Tour stops across Europe, Asia and North America, only the most motivated and talented young athletes have earned their chance to compete in the Finals. Zell am See-Kaprun will once again become the global stage where the future of snowboarding drops in.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: The First Second - Sam Anthamatten
programme.desc: A specialist in high mountains, Sam is a committed freerider, but behind his instinct to ski, there is a guide: it is his job, his culture. At each line, an internal struggle begins between security and risk-taking ... The balance is difficult, with great freedom involved. Through his practice, he lives and perpetuates a mythical image, that of the Zermatt guide.

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2026
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers. Fans from across the globe have the opportunity to witness the future of freeskiing unfold in real-time.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.2
programme.desc: Soleil généreux et neige fraîche ont servi de décor au nouvel épisode sportif qui s’est joué sur les pentes du Beaufortain, lors de cette 2e étape sur 4. programme.title: Lekkarod 2026
programme.desc: Depuis 11 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 11 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.4
programme.desc: La neige s’est invitée dans la station du Beaufortain en cette 4ᵉ et ultime étape de la Pierra Menta. Malgré des conditions météo difficiles, des milliers de spectateurs ont porté les enfants du pays, William Bon Mardion et Xavier Gachet, dans un ultime duel face à Samuel Équy et Anselme Damevin. Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel battent les favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret et Célia Périllat-Pessey, au terme d’une étape qu’elles ont dominée de la tête et des jambes.Snow arrived in the Beaufortain resort for this fourth and final stage of the Pierra Menta. Despite the challenging weather conditions, thousands of spectators cheered on local favorites William Bon Mardion and Xavier Gachet in a final duel against Samuel Équy and Anselme Damevin. Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel defeated favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret and Célia Périllat-Pessey, at the end of a stage they dominated from start to finish.

It is the second largest cross-country skiing event in the world and the largest cross-country skiing event in Switzerland. Among the large crowd of participants are also world-class runners.

programme.title: Florence Marathon - We run in art Eng
programme.desc: two select runners comment on their participation in the Florence marathon and the organizers provide unique insights on the Florence marathon.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Zurich Barcelona Marathon 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Welcome to the 47th edition of the Zurich Barcelona Marathon, this 2026 edition gathers not less than 32,000 entries with the field made-up of 60 international visitors from 100 different nationalities.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
programme.desc: The HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB is the final of four UTMB World Series majors in 2025, offering athletes a great opportunity to progress towards the UTMB World Series Finals. Celebrating its 6th edition with new and improved courses along with an even deeper connection to Thailands natural and cultural heritage, the event attracts over 7,200 participants, including 56 from the Asia region and an exceptional elite field across all distances.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2026 - Episode 3

The next stop on our journey is Spain. The Mallorca 312 OK Mobility, one of the most significant cycling events in the region, returns on 25 April 2026 for its 16th edition. From Mallorca, we then move to southern Spain. Andalusia has captivated hundreds of cyclists over the past decade as the host of the prestigious Andalucía Bike Race. We then head to Turin, Italy, for the 2026 Turin Foil Grand Prix. This annual fencing tournament, organized by the International Fencing Federation, brings together elite competitors in both the mens and womens foil disciplines.

He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.
